item.description:
Llumi 2.2.0 (build 5)
Start in background, independently of Launch at login. The compact menu-bar popup keeps real usage, reset times and refresh status available while the main window is closed, and follows Llumi appearance settings.
Optional usage alerts are off by default. After opting in, edit provider thresholds, track each quota window separately, and receive one highest newly crossed threshold per account/window. Stale or uncertain readings do not trigger alerts. Native permission feedback and a test notification are included.
Claude Code and Codex remain supported. Missing quota fields stay unknown. No new provider integrations are enabled in this release.
Existing Mac users must install this version manually once. Quit Llumi, replace Llumi.app in Applications with this signed and notarized version, and reopen it. Settings and provider-owned sign-ins are retained. Version 1.1.3 cannot obtain this update through its old signing key. Future compatible updates use a separate signed update feed.
